title: Evergreen inventory v1
description: The lifecycle of the resources named in cloud, cluster, container, and host exports that Evergreen was given. Evergreen reads the files only and never calls the provider.

importer.description: The importer that recognized the file.

file.description: The export file as given on the command line.

pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to the version value, or line:<n> for a text export.

resource.description: The resource's own short name. Never an account id, ARN, or secret.

purl.description: Version-less Package URL the lifecycle rules are written against.

unrecognized.description: Files no importer recognized or that could not be read, as given.
